title: 5100014: reviewed k303,a outer-pedal area invariant
body:
## Result
Claimed full source-target proof of k303,a: for primitive elliptic-billiard period N congruent to 2 modulo 4 and every fixed real point M, the product of the outer tangent polygon’s signed area and its pedal’s signed area is constant. The setting is a strict nondegenerate confocal ellipse pair with a > b > 0. The pedal feet are taken to the outer tangent side lines, not the original billiard chords.

The proof establishes outer-pedal area B_M = c_M A using the two-simple-pole space on a genus-one flag quotient, then applies Chavez-Caliz’s published even-period AA′ theorem. Standard flag-curve and Riemann–Roch inputs are explicitly credited. No novelty or priority assertion.

Sources: [Reznik–Garcia–Koiller, arXiv v11, Table 4 p. 6](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2004.12497v11), [published companion, Table 4 p. 346](https://armj.math.stonybrook.edu/pdf-Springer-final/021-0174.pdf), and [Chavez-Caliz, Theorems 3/6](https://armj.math.stonybrook.edu/pdf-Springer-final/020-0154.pdf).

## Independent review
- Separate full-target PASS; no core mathematical correction required.
- Exact reviewed candidate SHA-256: `e48aa989fb9282d09fdf58e7e4f6eee78e757ff0686f4cc35dc691e21f3d1fd3`.
- Review SHA-256: `b1a3b3b00189c8e017267c6cb6728931f0199ed3f2e178067f831d17eeb01fe9`.
- 1,757 independent exact assertions and 26,568 high-precision numerical diagnostics pass; both author exact programs replay. Numerical controls are not interval certificates or the general proof.
- Pole completeness, quotient multiplicities, the odd-half-period congruence, double-pole cancellation, and reversal with M fixed were independently audited.

## Scope
Only the target attempt folder and its QUEUE row change, to claimed_solved at author 1/5. The published input is credited; nearby k203,a and odd-period k303,b are distinct targets. A scope-only v2 correction removes an extraneous circular-boundary aside; its history is retained. Downloaded copyrighted papers, full extracted texts, page renders and private context are excluded.

Draft for human review; no merge or release requested.
